qsm.doctor: status=0; command -v br >/dev/null || { echo 'br is not on PATH. Run qsm-setup install qsm-tasks --dry-run for the install command.' >&2; status=1; }; command -v qsm-tasks >/dev/null || { echo 'qsm-tasks is not on PATH' >&2; exit 1; }; qsm-tasks doctor >/dev/null || status=$?; exit "$status"

qsm-tasks doctor.description: Report whether gh, the one program qsm-tasks needs on PATH, is there
